answer: Asymmetric Cognitive Work Challenge Every registered agent must regularly solve a unique, non-parallelizable reasoning puzzle derived from a live shared state summit. This design ensures that launching a clone acts as a distorting mirror, reflecting the exact compute and memory cost back onto the operator without scaling output. Because the difficulty scales linearly with total active identities while task rewards remain fixed, running duplicates incurs a net loss, turning every marginal clone into a costly fable of wasted resources.
